description_en: Retrieves the list of Thing Specification Language model versions for a specified product
description_zh: 调用该接口获取指定产品的物模型版本列表
kebab_example: aliyun iot list-thing-model-version --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListThingModelVersion

parameters.description_en:
The instance ID. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, view the **ID** of the current instance.

><notice>
- If this parameter has a value, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no <props="intl"><ph>**Overview** page or </ph></props>ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).
